Title: ARTEX Korean finance and Storm-0940 - ipv4
Description: Actor-controlled server that hosted the ARTEX instance and an open directory (port 18899) used against South Korean financial organisations; listed by CrowdStrike and the FBI. Source: CrowdStrike – Unknown Threat Actor Uses AI-Driven ARTEX to Target South Korean Finance https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/blog/unknown-threat-actor-uses-artex-to-target-south-korean-finance/
RecommendedActions: Block at the perimeter and in Defender XDR; search 30 days of firewall, proxy and sign-in logs and investigate any match.
